newsitem.title: USA: Thiokol Corp to consolidate unit.
newsitem.headline: Thiokol Corp to consolidate unit.

text.p: Thiokol Corp, which produces solid rocket motor propulsion systems, said it plans to consolidate its Northern Utah propulsion operations.
Thiokol said its space operations will be combined with the Defense & Launch Vehicles and Science and Engineering groups.
"This new organization will be more efficient and competitive. Consolidation costs will be minimal and are immediately offset by savings," said James Wilson, Thiokol chairman.
The new organization will be in place by July 1, and will report to Robert Crippen, president of the aerospace group.
Separately, Thiokol posted second quarter earnings of $18.7 million or $1.00 a share on sales of $210.0 million, compared with earnings of $22.3 million or $1.20 a share on sales of $209.9 million.
The company said it expects the last half of its fiscal year to be even stronger as margins at the fastening systems unit continue to expand and the Howmet unit's business continues to strengthen.
